title: Retrenchment Benefits for Unionised and Non-unionised Workers
what_it_is: Retrenchment Benefits for Unionised and Non-unionised Workers

sections.label: Retrenchment benefits survey findings
sections.summary: A 2013 survey on 2012 retrenchments found nine in 10 companies paid retrenchment benefits, and the next survey was brought forward from 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Based on the last survey conducted in 2013 for retrenchments carried out in 2012, nine in 10 companies paid retrenchment benefits, 68% of them came from manufacturing, wholesale and retail trade, and financial and insurance services; 80% were non-unionised companies, and 66% were small and medium enterprises employing between 25 and 199 employees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: The same survey showed that the prevailing norm was to pay a retrenchment benefit of between two weeks and one month of salary per year of service.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: In view of the current economic situation, we have brought forward the next survey due in 2017 to this year.

sections.label: Non-union members' recourse avenues
sections.summary: Non-union members with contractual notice or benefit terms can go to civil Courts, and from April 2017 to Employment Claims Tribunals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: For non-union members, if their contract stipulates a notice period or the retrenchment benefits quantum, they have recourse through the civil Courts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: And with the setting up of the Employment Claims Tribunals in April 2017, they will have a more affordable and expeditious avenue to resolve their contractual disputes, including retrenchment benefits.

sections.label: Quarterly retrenchment statistics surveys
sections.summary: Retrenchment statistics are collected through surveys conducted on a quarterly basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Retrenchment statistics are done through survey, so we do this on a quarterly basis.

sections.label: Employers' pre-retrenchment notification confidentiality concern
sections.summary: Many employers said their main concern about pre-retrenchment notification is confidentiality.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: On the part of the employers, many of them have expressed that for pre-retrenchment notification, their main concern is confidentiality.

sections.label: Tripartite retrenchment response taskforce
sections.summary: A tripartite retrenchment response taskforce was established early this year to offer timely employment facilitation to retrenched workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: But more importantly, we want to ensure that we can offer timely employment facilitation to those workers affected by retrenchment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: So, what we did was since early this year, we have established a tripartite retrenchment response taskforce, comprising of the Employment and Employability Institute, Workforce Development Agency, MOM and the National Trades Union Congress as well.

sections.label: Onsite job fairs and employment support
sections.summary: Job fairs may be organised onsite in a company if there is enough critical mass, with the aim of fair treatment and employment support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: We would even organise a job fair in the company, onsite, if there is enough critical mass.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: So, I think on the whole our primary concern is to ensure that the retrenched workers will receive not just a fair retrenchment treatment but, more importantly, are given the best employment support as well.
